title: The grocery basket
why: Seven things that are in every Czech fridge, including the rohlík, the national bread roll.

bridge.title: The čárka makes vowels long
bridge.note: Turkish doesn't mark long vowels. In Czech the accent mark ´ only means 'hold it longer'. Stress stays on the first syllable.

dialog.en: Excuse me, do you have rolls?

pattern.en: Do you have ___? Try: chleba, mléko, sýr.

silly.cz: Kočka jí sýr a pije mléko.
silly.en: The cat eats cheese and drinks milk.
Do you have a roll for the bear?

postcard.title: Rohlík nation
postcard.text: The rohlík is the everyday Czech bread roll, so popular that a big grocery delivery company is named after it.
